defaults.video_script: Four-one up. Messi's Barcelona still lost their tie with Roma in two thousand eighteen. Two own goals, Pique and Suarez: four-one at the Camp Nou. Barcelona led by three goals going to Rome. Edin Dzeko scored after six minutes at the Olimpico. Daniele De Rossi added a penalty in the fifty-eighth. Kostas Manolas scored the third in the eighty-second minute. Roma went through on away goals. Was this Barcelona's worst collapse with Messi?
defaults.video_subject: Barcelona led Roma 4-1 after the 2018 Champions League quarter-final first leg, then lost 3-0 at the Olimpico (Dzeko 6, De Rossi penalty 58, Manolas 82) and went out 4-4 on away goals.
